alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend latency deviation is far smaller (z=29.46 vs currencyservice z=195.25, E1), and frontend calls currencyservice, whose inbound latency rose 9.02x (E2). This fits downstream fallout.

Its latency-90 deviation (z=27.05, E1) is an order of magnitude below currencyservice's z=195.25. The only trace evidence of a large change is for currencyservice (E2), so cartservice looks secondary, though its own traces were not examined.
Its own span self-time stayed flat (0.14->0.13ms) while caller-observed time rose 5.17->46.61ms (E2). The extra time sits on the network path, not in CPU-bound processing.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the currencyservice pod's network path for injected latency, such as tc/netem rules or a chaos experiment, and remove it. Then confirm that caller-observed currencyservice latency returns to its baseline of about 5ms p50.
